import json, os, sys, traceback
def parse(s):
    return json.loads(s)
def load():
    try:
        parse("{bad")
    except ValueError as e:
        raise RuntimeError("config load failed") from e
def hook(t, e, tb):
    c = e.__cause__
    open(os.environ["OUT"], "w").write(json.dumps({
        "outer": "".join(traceback.format_exception(t, e, tb, chain=False)),
        "cause": "".join(traceback.format_exception(type(c), c, c.__traceback__, chain=False)),
        "name": t.__name__, "cname": type(c).__name__, "msg": str(e), "cmsg": str(c)}))
    sys.__excepthook__(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = hook
load()
